name: First User End-to-End Validation

blocking_defects.summary: Structured Analysis failed before the LLM call because a historical migration-version collision left action_plan_snapshots absent while version 008 was already recorded. Additive migration 014 repaired the missing table/index, readiness was hardened, and production service recovery passed; A06 must now be rerun by the first user.

usability_findings.summary: Registration UI does not expose username/password validation rules and reduces structured HTTP 422 validation details to a generic HTTP 422 message.

notes: A01 account registration/session flow passed after using a username that conforms to the existing canonical server validation contract.
A02 passed after the user explicitly saved an OpenAI-compatible provider configuration and the connection test succeeded.
A03 passed: the first user successfully created and selected a Person, a Relationship scoped to that Person, and a Conversation scoped to that Person.
A04 passed: four real Message records were explicitly added to the selected Conversation and remained present after refresh.
A05 passed: the first user confirmed the selected Person Timeline rendered the expected real evidence without reporting cross-person contamination or duplicate-on-refresh behavior.
The first A06 attempt displayed Failed to fetch because the local SSH tunnel had terminated; that attempt was an environment interruption rather than a product failure.

After the tunnel was restored, A06 returned HTTP 500. Server traceback identified sqlite3.OperationalError: no such table: action_plan_snapshots while constructing learning-strategy context before the provider call.

Read-only production schema audit confirmed migration versions 001 through 013 were recorded, SQLite integrity_check was ok, foreign_key_check was clean, and only the table and index defined by 008_action_plan_snapshots.sql were missing.
Git history established a historical migration-version collision. Historical migration 008 was not edited or deleted.
Additive migration 014 repaired the missing action_plan_snapshots table and index while preserving the historical 008 ledger entry.
Runtime readiness now verifies migration-declared table/index objects after migration-version parity, preventing the same schema drift from remaining falsely ready.

During server-side validation, migration 014 was applied to the production database before the production checkout contained 014, producing an expected-count/applied-count mismatch and causing watchdog restart attempts. The database remained integrity-clean and no restore was performed.

Production was recovered by aligning code to CI-verified TEST-156 head 0bdcc6064cd7dc8be88670d4ba8b0ffe7aa0bc97. live/ready/preflight passed, service became active with runtime PID 591899 and NRestarts 0, migration versions matched 001-014, and protected port 8899 remained PID 52822.
A verified SQLite online backup was created before production code alignment; no database restore was executed.

Pytest process-level isolation was added so test collection/execution defaults to a disposable temporary DATABASE_PATH before application imports, preventing server-side tests from falling back to the production absolute database path.
Safety CI run 35513527825 passed 16 focused safety tests, 170 auth regression tests, and 888 full-suite tests. Its temporary workflow was removed afterward.
No username, password, API key, real name, relationship detail, private chat content, or conversation identifier is recorded in this UAT artifact.
Real relationship and chat content remains in the production database and is not committed to GitHub.
Phase A remains blocked only on rerunning A06 against the repaired production runtime.
Phase B is longitudinal and should use genuine real-world events rather than synthetic completion.
